description.value: Château Okanagan is a European-inspired luxury estate on the shores of Okanagan Lake in Kelowna, BC, comprising two distinct properties — the Grand Residence and the Estate Villa — across 44 acres with a kilometre of private shoreline and on-site vineyards. Featured on Netflix's 'Million Dollar Secret,' it accommodates up to 24 guests across 12 rooms and offers a private spa, beach access, tennis court, and wine country setting. The Estate Villa allows individual room bookings, making it the more accessible option for solo cyclists or couples touring the Okanagan, though the entire estate is gated and advance reservation is required.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active luxury lakefront estate with two bookable properties; address, toll-free phone, and website URL all match OSM exactly. No mention of bike storage, bike handling procedures, laundry, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content; Wi-Fi is the only amenity confirmed by the website ('High-speed Wi-Fi throughout' on the Estate Villa packages page), corroborated by OSM internet_access=yes/fee=no. The contact page explicitly states the property is gated and 'not open to public tours or individual visits,' though individual rooms at the Estate Villa are bookable by advance reservation.
concerns: Property is gated and the contact page explicitly states it is 'not open to public tours or individual visits' — advance reservation is required and drop-in cyclist access is not possible.
OSM bar=yes not confirmed by website content.
OSM stars=5 not confirmed by website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating luxury accommodation with an active website and individual room bookings available at the Estate Villa; a notable stop in BC's Okanagan wine country for touring cyclists.
